signupNotice: By creating an account you agree to {{appName}}'s documents:
unavailable: This document can't be shown right now. Please try again in a moment.
acceptError: We couldn't record that. Please try again.

accept.title: One thing before you start
accept.subtitle: Your account was created through your identity provider, so you haven't seen these yet. Have a read, then agree to carry on.

cookies.label: Cookies
cookies.title: About cookies
cookies.body: {{appName}} keeps a few things in this browser to work at all — what keeps you signed in, the theme you picked, what you had open.
cookies.nothingOptional: That's the lot. Nothing else is kept, and nothing follows you to other sites.
cookies.optionalIntro: Anything beyond that is yours to decide.
cookies.spamCheck: The sign-up form, and the form that emails you a sign-in code, load a spam check from {{provider}}, which sets a cookie of its own.

necessary.name: Essential
necessary.description: Signing in, your preferences, and what you had open. There is no version of Initiative without these.

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.description: Which pages get used, the errors people run into and how fast pages load, with the browser and device they happen on. Grouped by a random id for each visit, never by your account.

marketing.name: Marketing
marketing.description: Which link brought you here, and reaching you about Initiative somewhere else.
